device.description: 14-bit 2.5 MSPS differential-input SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial interface
device.note: ads7057.pdf (SBAS821) p.3 pin configuration and functions, p.4 recommended operating conditions, p.7 timing requirements and switching characteristics (Figures 1-2), p.19 transfer characteristics (Table 2), p.21 CNV state / serial interface (Figure 37), p.22-23 offset calibration (OFFCAL state)

pages: p.3 (pins), p.4 (ROC), p.7 (timing, Figures 1-2), p.19 (transfer characteristics), p.21 (Figure 37 serial interface), p.22-23 (offset calibration)
notModeled: analog input (differential input (two's complement, 0 V = 0000h)); conversion is clocked by SCLK (18 SCLK falling edges, not timed: the result is the 0 V code at once)
pipelined output: each frame shifts out the previous conversion (the first frame after power-up is all zeros, which the 0 V code already is); with a constant code this is not observable
fewer than 18 SCLK falling edges in a frame gives an invalid result in the next frame
offset calibration (OFFCAL state: 24 SCLKs in the first frame after power-up, 64 SCLKs in a frame during normal operation; SDO outputs 0s)
throughput, acquisition time and SCLK frequency limits
tFloat: the datasheet gives only a 5.5 ns minimum for tdz_CSDO
